This site hosts interactive, serverless course modules powered by [**Quarto Live**](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/) (WebAssembly via Pyodide & webR). All computation runs directly in the student's browser—no backend server required.

## Available Embeddable Lessons

Each lesson page hides the top navigation bar (`navbar: false`) so it embeds cleanly inside a Canvas LMS course page:

1. [**Control statements in Python**](lessons/python-control.qmd) – covers Boolean logic, `in`, `if`, `else`, `elif`, and `for` loops.
2. [**"Formatted strings in Python"**](lessons/python-fstrings.qmd) – covers formatted strings, modifiers, and handling dictionary values.
3. [**Getting started with NumPy**](lessons/python-numpy.qmd) – covers importing NumPy, `ndarray`, and some array operations.

---

## Embedding into Canvas

1. Open your Canvas Page and click **Edit**.
2. Switch to the **HTML Editor (`</>`)** in the Rich Content Editor.
3. Paste the `<iframe>` snippet below (replacing <lesson-name> with the desired lesson name. Open the webpage and check the URL):

```html
<iframe
  src="https://williamngiam.github.io/quarto-demos/lessons/<lesson-name>.html"
  width="100%"
  height="750px"
  style="border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px;"
  title="Interactive Python Lesson">
</iframe>
<p style="font-size: 0.9em; margin-top: 0.4em;">
  <a href="https://williamngiam.github.io/quarto-live-test/lessons/<lesson-name>.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    Open interactive activity in a new tab ↗
  </a>
</p>
```
